text: Short-term rental services have disrupted housing markets across Canada, with apartments and houses being converted from traditional long-term housing rentals into short-term rentals. The City’s Short-Term Rental Program aims to limit short-term rental activity to principal residences and safeguard long-term rental residential housing. City Council approved regulations to govern short-term rentals in late 2017 and 2018, following public consultations. Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 547, alongside zoning regulations, requires individuals to register if they want to offer short-term rentals and short-term rental companies to obtain licenses. Under these rules, individuals can host short-term rentals on their principal residence for less than 28 consecutive days.
